reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited text supports it: § 19.1 gives the professional/workmanlike and material-conformance warranties, § 19.2 gives a 90-day Deliverable conformance period (measured from the later of delivery or acceptance) plus hosted Services conformance for the whole subscription term, § 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and compliance-with-Applicable-Law, and § 19.4 supplies the re-perform/repair/replace then terminate-and-refund remedy ladder — matching the preferred position on every material term.

The disclaimer in § 19.5 is limited to implied warranties and expressly states that no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or stated remedy, so the express warranty is not swallowed and there is no 'AS IS' walk-away exposure.

The failed deterministic check is explained by phrasing only ('ninety days' spelled out rather than numerals); substantively the 90-day period meets the benchmark, so the heuristic miss does not undermine the classification.
No redline or counterparty comment was proposed, which is the correct output for a compliant finding; the rendered redline is identical to the original paragraphs.
